The '''Strategic Information Service base''' was a base of operations during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] located in [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
